notes: v2.9.36: watermelon display is sharply reduced and aligned with the Bowl-3 pre-break preparation zone. A watermelon marker can display only when price has spent a long period below EMA224 (at least 70 of the last 100 eligible bars), current price is within Â±2% of EMA224, a 112-bar record-volume event occurred within the last 20 bars, 60<112<224 reverse alignment or a recent EMA112 reclaim is present, and recent concentrated-capital/accumulation evidence exists.
